verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents a drag-and-drop email editor, segmentation, and campaign creation through both the API and its MCP server. Composer is said to build the audience, draft the content, and map out the send strategy, and the free plan counts monthly email sends, which together cover the core compose → audience → send loop. missing for 10: explicit documentation of choosing a campaign's recipient list/segment and of scheduling a campaign send (only an implied 'send strategy' and an ambiguous 'Schedule recurring tasks'), plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end campaign send.
